| 4. Raw only, 8x compression (optimistic) | 2.737 | 63 | 110 | 21.9/8 = 2.7375 TB |

| 7. Same as 6 at 3x (recommended budget case) | 14.76 | 339 | 590 | churn 60 GB/3 = 0.02 TB; 14.6 + 0.02 + 0.14 = 14.76 TB |
| 8. Ceiling: CLEAN fully rewritten daily at 3x (TT 1 + FS 7 generations) | 73 | 1,679 | 2,920 | 7.3 raw + 7.3 CLEAN + 8 x 7.3 = 73 TB; avoid by incremental MERGE |

## Reading the table
- Headline: 21.9 TB (about 22 TB) uncompressed per year of raw events. Billed size is likely 2.7-7.3 TB for raw only (scenarios 2-4), i.e. $63-$168/month at $23 (assumption, 2016 price).
- Budget case: scenario 7, 14.76 TB, about $339/month at $23 or $590/month at $40 (2016 prices, assumptions).
- Time Travel and Fail-safe are small as long as CLEAN is updated incrementally (MERGE on a trailing window, not a full rebuild); scenario 8 shows the ceiling if it is rewritten daily.
- Year-1 average is about half of these figures if the table grows linearly from zero; the table shows end-of-year size.
- Lever: keep RAW.CLICK_EVENTS to a short retention (e.g. 30 days) after dedup; not modelled here.

Rules assumed from general knowledge [unverified]: changed or deleted micro-partitions stay billable for the Time Travel period (1 day, the standard default) and then for 7 days in Fail-safe; an append-only table adds almost nothing, a rewritten table keeps old generations.
- Dedup copy assumed equal in size to raw (upper bound; real duplicates are a few percent [unverified]).

## Scenario table (scenario x TB x monthly USD)
Monthly USD = TB x price. Both 2016 prices shown as assumptions: capacity $23 [S3], on-demand $40 [S3].

| Scenario | TB stored | Monthly USD @ $23 (assumption, 2016) | Monthly USD @ $40 (assumption, 2016) | Arithmetic |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1. Uncompressed reference (not what Snowflake bills) | 21.9 | 504 | 876 | 21.9 TB x $23 = $503.7; x $40 = $876 |
| 2. Raw only, 3x compression (conservative) | 7.3 | 168 | 292 | 21.9/3 = 7.3 TB |
| 3. Raw only, 5x compression (planning base) | 4.38 | 101 | 175 | 21.9/5 = 4.38 TB |
| 4. Raw only, 8x compression (optimistic) | 2.737 | 63 | 110 | 21.9/8 = 2.7375 TB |
| 5. Raw + deduped copy, 5x | 8.76 | 201 | 350 | 4.38 + 4.38 = 8.76 TB (dedup copy assumed = raw size, upper bound) |

## Reading the table
- Headline: 21.9 TB (about 22 TB) uncompressed per year of raw events. Billed size is likely 2.7-7.3 TB for raw only (scenarios 2-4), i.e. $63-$168/month at $23 (assumption, 2016 price).
- Budget case: scenario 7, 14.76 TB, about $339/month at $23 or $590/month at $40 (2016 prices, assumptions).
- Time Travel and Fail-safe are small as long as CLEAN is updated incrementally (MERGE on a trailing window, not a full rebuild); scenario 8 shows the ceiling if it is rewritten daily.
- Year-1 average is about half of these figures if the table grows linearly from zero; the table shows end-of-year size.
- Lever: keep RAW.CLICK_EVENTS to a short retention (e.g. 30 days) after dedup; not modelled here.

## What this does not cover
Current Oct 2026 Snowflake price (region/edition/contract), measured compression on real events, official Time Travel/Fail-safe billing docs, compute and Snowpipe Streaming ingest costs, and cross-region/replica copies.
